assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina NovaSeq 6000, HISAT2 + featureCounts, mm10), mouse knee joint
primary_estimand: Effect of cartilage-specific Loxl2 deletion (Tm-induced Acan-CreERT2; Loxl2fl/fl) on knee-joint gene expression in DMM-induced post-traumatic OA mice (Loxl2-/- DMM vs Loxl2 WT/vehicle DMM). Genotype contrast within injured mice; no exercise arm.
sample_inclusion: 8 knee-joint samples, n = 4 per condition (S2.3.p1, S4.8.p1): Vehicle_DMM_LOXL2wt x4, KO_DMM_LOXL2ko x4
planned_contrasts: KO_DMM vs Vehicle_DMM (Fig. 3b, S2.3.p1; paper: ~4046 DEGs at padj < 0.05, Table S1)
exercise_role: Treadmill exhaustion test (S2.7.p1, S4.5.p1, Fig. 7) is a functional/pain readout in a separate adenovirus-LOXL2 intra-articular cohort; those mice were not sequenced. No exercise intervention or exercise-vs-sedentary factor exists in the RNA-seq design.
paper_method: DESeq2 Wald test, BH adjustment (S4.8.p1, S4.10.p1)
paper_results: ~4046 DEGs padj < 0.05; Mmp13, Postn, Col1a1 up; Thbs2, Cdh11, Col3a1 up (S2.3.p1)
